crossRefs.note: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t…
The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.
I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”
For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through…
and if children, then heirs: heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also…
Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of…
you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He…
He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,
as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,
the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,
that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.
translations.bsb: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
translations.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.
translations.asv: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise: but God hath granted it to Abraham by promise.
